sections.content:
For other uses, see Hilda.

Hilda is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. She is a Demonlord of Nogreth and the leader of Chilling Beauties.

sections.title: In Brave Frontier I
sections.content: As part of the Battles of Brave Frontier 2 series, Hilda can be fought in Chilling Beauties.
